4477-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4477-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3836-4659-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Urza, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

512-2085-8190.easyPrerequisites: Loot and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-2085-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with different powers.
512-2085-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2085-8190.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Loot's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4549-7316--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-6634.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

252-4231-5394-7292.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-4231-5394-7292.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

907-1558-2638-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-2638-4231-7824.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1580-4871-5686-6248.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7719-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

687-2404-5226-6099.notablePrerequisites: There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
687-2404-5226-6099.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
687-2404-5226-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-5879-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Walking Archive.
When Walking Archive dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Walking Archive enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5961-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

856-997-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

880-5478-7201.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5478-7201.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2026-3525-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.

2173-2403-4771-5220.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

483-2173-4771-5220.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2523-5231-5297.description:
Activate Sarkhan's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing it to become a legendary 4/4 Dragon creature with flying, indestructible and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sarkhan.
When Sarkhan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sarkhan that isn't legendary.
Repeat using the Sarkhan token.

2530-2577-2811-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-2811-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Elas il-Kor's first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger from the Zombie Druid entering the battlefield, and Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers from Gravecrawler dying.
Resolve the first Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the second Elas il-Kor trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1786-3591-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1786-3591-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

2084-6106.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-6106.description:
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

4089-5011-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2178-2527-3143-5256.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2178-2527-3143-5256.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

509-4222-4306.notablePrerequisites:
Idris does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Idris.
509-4222-4306.description:
Activate Idris using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Idris.
Repeat.

2529-4377-4423.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

18-3457.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one other card in hand.
18-3457.description:
Cast Hangar Scrounger by paying {2}{R}.
When Hangar Scrounger enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Seeker of Skybreak and causing it to gain the printed ability until end of turn.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Seeker of Skybreak triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability from step 3, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

864-2963-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

232-1636-3337.notablePrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
232-1636-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
The Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

195-1528-5195.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness.
195-1528-5195.description:
Cast Chain Stasis by paying {U}, targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Chain Stasis targeting the creature with Dual Casting attached.
 Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Chain Stasis, untapping the creature with Dual Casting attached and choosing not to copy Chain Stasis.
Repeat from step 3.

4112-4273.description:
Cast Copy Artifact by paying {1}{U}.
Copy Artifact enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Copy Artifact triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

2342-4944.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor's 0 mana ability targeting a creature you control.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
